            How scoring works

            Escape for 1,000 points on Story, 1,600 on Standard, or 2,400 on Nightmare. Add 100 for each life remaining and 2 for each full second under 10 minutes. A loss earns 0. Escape-rate ranks require five verified games in the selected period. Weeks begin Monday in UTC.

            Blackmere House Survival guide

            How to Play

            Find a way out before the end of night five. If she catches you, you wake in the bedroom with your items and escape progress.

            Movement

            Look

            Stay quiet

            Crouch to muffle your steps or drop a tool to draw her away. Directional captions show nearby footsteps and other loud sounds. You can turn them off in Settings.

            Touch and controller

            Use the joystick to move and drag the scene to look. On a controller, use both sticks, A to interact, B to crouch, right trigger to sprint, X for light, and Menu to pause. Granny uses L3 for a snare and R3 for a door bolt.

            Landscape gives you a wider view on phones.

              Blackmere House Home screen

              Install Blackmere House

              In Safari on iPhone or iPad, open Share and choose Add to Home Screen. In other supported browsers, look for Install or Add to Home screen in the browser menu.

              After the offline files finish downloading, you can play Single Player without a connection. Online matches and account features require internet access.
